svg.aria-label: Decision flow for every analysed message. If a person already handles the case, the assistant drafts for the agent. Otherwise, high or critical severity hands it to a person with a note in the customer's language. A cancellation, billing dispute or proposed write also goes to a person. A calm message with a help-article match of at least 0.65 is answered from the article and closed. Everything else gets an assistant reply in the customer's language and stays open.
